title: Concept Scene Graph
description: Structure an LLM returns to describe a concept diagram. The LLM authors structure and semantics (nodes, edges, hierarchy); the renderer owns particle physics. Positions are abstract layout coordinates (roughly -20..20 per axis), never raw particle coordinates. Referential rules the validator enforces on top of this schema: node ids are unique; edge from/to and node parent must reference existing node ids; no self-edges; parent links must be acyclic.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Voice navigation resolves to these.

description.description: 1-2 plain-language sentences. Used as grounding context for scoped LLM explanations, not just display.

size.description: Cluster radius in layout units; also weights how many particles the node receives.

shape.description: Cluster silhouette: default fuzzy ball, or a wide flat slab (used for stacked layer bands). Only meaningful on leaf nodes — parents render as their children.

parent.description: Id of the containing node, or null for top-level nodes. Drives zoom/focus subtree resolution.
